currentState: Old friends at a hard moment. Warm on his side (he laughs at the sight of her, uses her first name in front of everyone, sees her hurt hands at once, squeezes her arm, apologises, feeds her), and he believes her ('I don't doubt you', 'I believe you'). He still turns to the visible war and sends her to write it down for his father. Jaina arrived expecting the history to buy a second look at the paper; she leaves angry at him and at herself, sure she was not unfair to the boy in the bracken, and keeping the memory from Sylvanas. She does not hate him; she cannot rely on him.
powerDynamic: Rank and ground favour Arthas (prince, in command, in his camp, the one who decides what the conversation is about, who can turn her by the shoulder to face the valley). Jaina's lever is history and facts. He is kind and uses courtesy like a shield; she cannot move him with proof.

physicalDynamics.pattern: He comes between the tents at a long stride and laughs; she greets him in her 'old voice'. He takes in her wrapped hand and dead arm. He folds his arms and sets his weight to hear her. He bends over the sheet and touches the knife slit with one gloved finger. He puts a hand on her shoulder and turns her to face the valley. He squeezes her dead right arm in apology and she feels nothing. He goes up the lane without taking the paper.

nameUsage.arthasCallsJaina: 'Jaina' warmly, often; 'Jaina Proudmoore, on my hill' for show; 'Jaina. I don't doubt you.'
nameUsage.jainaCallsArthas: 'Arthas' aloud when asking him to listen; 'Your Highness' once as a teasing joke at first sight (with the sergeant's hearing); in narration 'Arthas'.

history.event: Years ago, the year she went to Dalaran, Arthas dared Jaina to crawl to an orc internment camp's fence by the watchtower gap. He was sure the orcs were beasts; she saw a female humming to an infant. He was as sure after. She never said what she thought.

Chapter 6: first reunion on the page at Strahnbrad. Jaina delivers the warning; he believes it and chooses the Garrow farm and the war he can see. He tells her to write it down for his father. Jaina is left holding the paper; Sylvanas had called it.

trajectory: Old closeness -> tested and found insufficient. Jaina stops looking to him for rescue. His promise: a rider to Terenas tonight, Andorhal when the hills are quiet. Later chapters can make this a live cost (the Arthas price is told at sea in Ch19, per plan; the camp memory is not told to Sylvanas before then).
